summary: Mapping specification with citations (hist06-addbiomechanics-mapping.json), a read-only probe of all 33 participants (peak RSS 139.4 MiB, nice 19 / ionice idle), the adapter, a guarded pilot runner and synthetic tests are written. Key findings: (1) the 23 DOF columns are the 25 model coordinates minus the two enforced-coupled knee_angle_*_beta coordinates; reading the first 23 by order is refuted (dof10 would equal dof09; it differs by up to 1.86 rad). (2) The dynamics model defines hip flexion, knee flexion, ankle dorsiflexion and their generalized forces positive in the named direction, so every sagittal joint channel maps with sign +1 to rule B. (3) The source pelvis_tilt is a ground-relative Euler angle: Falisse sit-to-stand and all Tan running trials face world -z, where it is pelvic obliquity; the adapter derives the pelvis pitch from the full pelvis orientation. (4) Tan running pelvis yaw differs from the treadmill axis by up to 35 deg, so the walking direction comes from within-stance CoP displacement (treadmill) or COM travel (overground). (5) Plate weight matches the entered Falisse masses within 6 % but the fitted masses only within 40 %. Pre-launch review (HIST-06-verify.json round 1) passed every mapping item; F1 fixed per the coordinator's ruling (recorded force kept on flagged frames, flag carried, strides from recorded force), F2 fixed. Re-review round 2: F3 (unloaded CoP placeholder) and F4 (docstring) fixed; spec v1r5. Falisse has no heel-to-heel stride in its recorded force (one plate contact per foot), so FA16 still falls back to blocks; reported, not worked around.

mapping_summary.dof_order: H23: model order without knee_angle_r_beta and knee_angle_l_beta (dof06 hip_flexion_r, dof09 knee_angle_r, dof10 ankle_angle_r, dof13 hip_flexion_l, dof16 knee_angle_l, dof17 ankle_angle_l, dof20-22 lumbar)
mapping_summary.sagittal_joints: hip_flexion/knee_angle/ankle_angle pos (rad) -> hip_flexion/knee_flexion/ankle_dorsiflexion_angle_{ipsi,contra}_rad, sign +1 by model definition; tau (N*m, generalized force) -> *_moment_*_Nm, +1. Published only through the CORE-11 hook (audited table decides).
mapping_summary.pelvis: pelvis_sagittal_angle_rad = asin(up component of the pelvis anterior axis) from dof00-02; front up positive (rule B). Published only when both legs publish it with one sign.
mapping_summary.segments_velocities: thigh/shank/foot angles and every velocity derived after the hook from published channels (sign_application.derive_segment_angles, derive_angular_velocities with the source timestep). Source dofNN_vel/acc not mapped.
mapping_summary.frontal_transverse: hip_adduction and hip_rotation angle and moment, source sign (adduction +, internal rotation + both sides); no frontal/transverse rule adopted yet.
mapping_summary.grf_cop: calcn_r/l force and CoP (world, on the foot) -> grf_vertical/anterior/lateral_*_N and cop_*_m in the rule-B frame: x' = measured walking direction, y' = up, z' = x' x y'; lateral outward per leg. Force recorded on every frame (flag carried unchanged as missing_grf_reason; empty only where the source is NaN; zeros stay zero). CoP empty where that foot's recorded vertical force is not positive (source (0,0,0) placeholder), independent of the flag. Anterior/lateral empty without forward locomotion.
mapping_summary.not_mapped: subtalar, mtp, lumbar, pelvis translations and raw pelvis Euler angles, contact torques, Falisse seat contact, COM, root residual (kept in the HIST-05 files)
mapping_summary.rows: one row per source frame and reference leg (reference_side right and left, ipsi = that leg); identity (subject, source_recording_id, observation_id = source segment name, reference_side)
mapping_summary.task: MAP-TAN-TASK applied (non-protocol names: task null, in_task_table false, task_id = source name); Tan running protocol trials run; Tan walking and Falisse labels only from D-HIST-06-2
mapping_summary.normalization: _Nm_kg and _BW divide by the recorded participant mass (entered_mass_kg) under José's standing rule (2026-11-02); the fitted dynamics-model mass is never used to normalize. Missing or non-positive recorded mass: those columns empty.

agent_decisions_logged: Both reference legs written as separate observations (contract: both reference legs may be represented with explicit identities). No side is privileged; a converter flag can drop to one leg.

Superseded by the coordinator's F1 ruling (2026-11-02, José's keep-recorded-values rule): recorded GRF and CoP are written on every frame; the AddBiomechanics flag is carried unchanged as missing_grf_reason; only source NaN stays empty; recorded zeros stay zero; strides come from the recorded vertical force.
Walking direction measured per trial (treadmill CoP axis, overground COM travel), checked against the pelvis facing within 45 deg; failing trials get no anterior/lateral values.

The model definition is passed to the hook as documentation only (never applies a sign). No forward-kinematics joint positions are passed as marker evidence: they restate the model definition and would not be independent data.

items.question: Tan walking has normal walking plus three deliberately modified gaits (toe angle, step width, trunk sway), and Falisse has walking, stair ascent and sit-to-stand-to-sit trials. Which of these trials should get LocoHub task labels? Unlabelled trials stay in the files under their source names but in no task table.

options.label: Plain walking and stair ascent only (129 segments)
options.consequence: Tan normal walking and Falisse walking labelled level walking, Falisse stairs stair ascent; 714 modified-gait and 34 sit-to-stand segments unlabelled. Reversible.

options.label: Also modified gaits as level walking (843 segments)
options.consequence: As A, plus 714 modified-gait segments labelled level walking, with the modification as the task variant; sit-to-stand unlabelled. Reversible.

options.label: Also sit-to-stand (877 segments)
options.consequence: As B, plus 34 Falisse sit-to-stand-to-sit segments labelled sit-to-stand, although each also contains the sit-down. Reversible.

items.why: Modified gaits change the very signals level-walking tables summarize, and a sit-to-stand-to-sit trial is two transfers; both stay available under their source names. A labels only what matches one LocoHub task without qualification.
items.check: Tan walking trial names are exactly baseline, fpa, step_width and trunk_sway (843 segments; 105 baseline).
items.cost_of_waiting: Tan walking and Falisse trials stay unlabelled and in no task table; Tan running, all signals and other datasets are unaffected.
items.standing_rule_note: José's 2026-11-02 rule (fix only blatant errors; keep recorded values) does not settle this: each option keeps every recorded value and source name, and the choice is which LocoHub task families to assign, i.e. scope. The least-change option is A: it assigns a label only where the recorded trial name already names one LocoHub task (normal walking, stair ascent) and reinterprets nothing. Kept as a José decision; this note is not shown to José on the sheet (the recommendation stays folded).
